files.name: motion-prompt-103.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Golden hour" (ゴールデンアワー), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #103

What it is: The low, warm light just after sunrise or before sunset
What the sample shows: The sun drops to just above the horizon; sky and ground turn orange, the left side of the person lights up and the shadows of the lamp and tree stretch far to the right.
Spec:
- Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). 
- Sun: radius 18 px, from (x 110, y −30) to (x 96, y 136), half hidden by the hills
- Colour: sky #FAF9F7 → #FFE8BC at the top and #FFCF80 near the horizon, ground #F1F0EE → #F6DDB0; light on the figure #FFB547, shadow #3E3650
- Head: light from the left at about 66°, shadow right of the edge; body lit on the left, shadow on the right
- Shadows: from the foot of the lamp and tree to the right, length 0 → 150 px (#DDAA6E); top-right time 12:00 → 17:40
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: For warm, nostalgic, gentle-feeling images.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/103.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
